description: This file defines the 'Information' class within the 'Opencart\Catalog\Model\Catalog' namespace, providing methods to retrieve information data from a database, such as individual information entries, lists of information entries, and associated layout IDs.
external_files: Opencart\System\Engine\Model (implied, as it extends this class)

classes.name: Information
classes.description: A model class responsible for fetching information entries and their layout IDs from the database within the OpenCart catalog module.

methods.name: getInformation
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information for a specific information ID, taking into account language and store context.

methods.name: getInformations
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all information entries relevant to the current language and store.

methods.name: getLayoutId
methods.description: Fetches the layout ID associated with a specific information entry.
